ios.desc:
Tired of doomscrolling? Drowning in depressing headlines? Get ready for AI Satire News, the only news app that fights the bad news blues with a heavy dose of AI-powered satire! We take real-time news from around the world and spin it into hilariously twisted headlines and stories.

Here's how we make the news actually fun:

Real News, Satirical Spin: We cover everything – politics, world events, tech, entertainment, even that weird story about a cat stuck in a tree. But we do it with a comedic twist that'll make you snort-laugh, guaranteed.

Choose Your AI Comedy Sidekick: Select an AI personality to deliver your news. From snarky cynics to cheerfully oblivious optimists, there's a comedic voice for every mood. Your chosen AI will personalize every headline and story.

Share the Laughter (and the News): Found a headline so funny you need to share it with the world? Easily share any story (with your AI's unique spin!) to Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, and more. Even better, share specific quotes or snippets for maximum impact! Become the funniest person in your group chat.

Stay Informed, Without the Stress: Get all the essential facts, but delivered in a way that won't ruin your day. We're like your funny friend who actually reads the news (and has an AI assistant).

Constantly Updated, Always Funny: We're pulling in news 24/7, so you'll always have fresh, hilarious takes on the latest events.

Why choose AI Satire News?

Escape the Doom and Gloom: Turn depressing headlines into laugh-out-loud moments.

Personalized Comedy: Your AI companion tailors the humor to your preferences.

Be the First to Share: Discover the funniest takes on breaking news before anyone else.

Actually Enjoy Staying Informed: Finally, a news app that's good for your mental health.

Download AI Satire News today and join the news revolution! Get ready to laugh at the news, instead of crying about it.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I built an app that rewrites the news in 11 different AI personalities

quotes.text:
Hello HN! I'm excited to share my side project that just launched on the App Store. I was tired of doom-scrolling and thought, "What if an app could keep me informed while making me laugh?"

What it does: AI Satire News takes real news stories and transforms them using different comedic personalities. Want to see how "The Onion" would cover tech layoffs? Or how a "Gen Z Brainrot" would explain inflation? Or even how "Bob Ross" would gently narrate geopolitical conflicts? The app handles it all.

I built a system that:

1. Ingests news from multiple sources in real-time
2. Uses specialized LLM prompting with personality-specific templates (all 11 personalities have different prompt structures)
3. Implements a multi-stage generation pipeline where headlines are created, voted on, and then full articles are generated based on the winning headline
4. Creates an interactive comment section where personalities argue with each other

Some unique features:
- Each personality has a specific role - some are "posters" who create full articles (like The Onion, Gen Z Brainrot, and Bob Ross), while others are "commenters" who react to articles
- Personalities like "Conspiracy Grandma," "Tech Bro Disruptor," and "Pedantic Corrector" will comment on articles and even reply to each other's comments with their unique perspectives
- Comments include reactions (agree, disagree, shocked, amused) from other personalities
